title: Stratum-Parallel Causal Dependencies and Amortized Bounds in the Aether-Parallel Levenshtein Axiom-Matrix
author: Mateus Yonathan

abstract: This paper investigates the algorithmic mechanics of the Aether-Parallel Levenshtein Axiom-Matrix, a Axiom-Interpreter-based implementation that computes edit distance via anti-diagonal stratum processing. We formalize the causal dependency graph inherent in dynamic programming matrices, demonstrating that stratum-level parallelism preserves the strict height-balanced and key-ordered invariants of the underlying search structure. By mapping the algorithm to a balanced search archetype, we derive theoretical asymptotic bounds for point and range search operations. The analysis relies on static Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) inspection and formal invariant proofs, avoiding empirical wall-clock measurements. We verify that the implementation maintains deterministic thread-safety through read-only access to previously completed strata. This work provides a rigorous structural decomposition of parallel edit distance computation, establishing foundational complexity guarantees for future distributed string matching systems. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/Axiom-Interpreter-advanced-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261106_050205_chronos-parallel_levenshtein_d}.
